Name: Niu Lai Cows - Meme Cow Replacer and Voice Pack
Author: MiyamizuMiyoku
Description:
[code]牛来来到了星露谷！
Niu Lai has come to Stardew Valley!

【中文介绍】

这是我第一次制作 Mod。代码、像素素材、音效接入、调试、打包和页面文案全部使用 ChatGPT 完成。

灵感来自《怪物猎人：崛起》中“用牛来替换金狮子”的 Mod。

这个 SMAPI Mod 会把棕牛、白牛以及对应的小牛替换成牛来风格的像素形象。成年牛会发出经典的“牛来”语音，小牛则会喊“妈妈”。

功能：

- 替换成年棕牛和白牛的外观
- 替换对应的小牛外观
- 成年牛叫声替换为“牛来”
- 小牛叫声替换为“妈妈”
- 包含单独优化的动物列表头像
- 不修改产奶、成长、怀孕、好感度或存档数据

安装方法：

1. 安装 SMAPI 4.5.0 或更高版本。
2. 下载并解压本 Mod。
3. 将 NiulaiCow 文件夹放入 Stardew Valley/Mods。
4. 通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。

不需要安装 Content Patcher。

兼容性：

适用于 Stardew Valley 1.6.15 或更高版本。同一个安装包可用于 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Steam Deck。

其他替换相同奶牛贴图或牛叫声的 Mod 可能与本 Mod 冲突。macOS 版本尚未经过实机测试。

卸载方法：

关闭游戏，然后删除 Mods 文件夹中的 NiulaiCow 文件夹。本 Mod 不修改存档，卸载后奶牛会恢复原版外观和声音。


【English Description】

This is the first mod I have ever made. Every part of its production—including the code, pixel assets, audio integration, troubleshooting, packaging, and mod-page description—was completed using ChatGPT.

The original inspiration came from a Monster Hunter Rise mod which replaces Rajang with Niu Lai.

This SMAPI mod replaces brown cows, white cows, and their calves with an intentionally absurd Niu Lai-inspired pixel design. Adult cows use the classic “Niu Lai!” voice clip, while calves call out “Mama!”.

Features:

- Replaces adult brown and white cow sprites
- Replaces the matching calf sprites
- Adult cows say the classic “Niu Lai!” line
- Calves call out “Mama!”
- Includes a separately polished animal-list icon
- Does not modify milk production, growth, pregnancy, friendship, or save data

Installation:

1. Install SMAPI 4.5.0 or later.
2. Download and extract the archive.
3. Place the NiulaiCow folder inside Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

Content Patcher is not required.

Compatibility:

Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later. The same download is intended for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Steam Deck.

Mods which replace the same cow textures or sounds may conflict. The macOS version has not yet been tested on physical Mac hardware.

Uninstallation:

Close the game and delete the NiulaiCow folder from the Mods directory. This mod does not modify save data.[/code]
